name: Chokro
tagline: A working prototype exploring participation in a more circular local economy.
summary: Chokro is presented here as a working prototype, not as a publicly available service. Its relationship to Impact Sol, public-use rights and any future launch route must be documented before stronger claims are published.
ownershipNote: The relationship, ownership and public-use rights must be confirmed and recorded before launch.
intendedUsers: 3ZERO Champions as a Chokro product-role label
3ZERO Greenpreneurs as a Chokro product-role label
3ZERO Admins as a Chokro product-role label
currentCapabilities: Registered-bin disposal journeys with proportionate evidence checks
A trusted internal points ledger and initiative contribution categories
Prototype seller, catalogue, cart and checkout journeys
currentLimitations: Public availability and production app or QR routes are not verified
The endorsed Impact Sol relationship and asset rights are not documented
Physical operations, seller base, inventory and outcome claims are not evidenced
Payment journeys are simulations and move no real money
geography: Designed for Bangladesh, with a focused Dhaka pilot planned rather than claimed as operating.
privacyStatus: Product-specific privacy, processor, retention, location-data and photo-data information requires approval before public use.
supportStatus: No approved public product-support route or service expectation is published; use the corporate register-interest route.

representativeVisual.caption: Provisional Chokro prototype icon used only in the product context; final rights confirmation remains a launch gate.
